**YMCA of Oakville.** The YMCA's own page says its Preschool Swim Lessons are for 3 to 5 year olds. 
Its swim lessons and aquatics programs run in 12-week sessions with a one week break between sessions.
 I found no class days, times or fees on the page.

**Town of Oakville.** 
The Town offers lessons under the Lifesaving Society Swim for Life program.
 Its rates document lists 
"All Preschool Levels A - E"
, but I found no ages, schedule or price for those levels. The fall registration timing matters most for this one:
- 
Fall registration opened Tuesday, August 11 at 7 a.m.
, so most fall classes are likely well underway or full.
- 
Winter registration opens Tuesday, December 1 at 7 a.m., and program options can be browsed online from November 24.


**Making Waves Swim School.** This is a private swim school whose Oakville page lists 
2-5 years (Little Waves)
. The page shows two different per-lesson prices for that class and doesn't say which applies, so I haven't given one. I found no class times either.
